notes: Fixed a bug where finishing a match could send you back into the Academy tutorial and leave you stuck there, even if you had already graduated. Several places that record match rewards or start a challenge/story/trial battle were saving your profile back to disk without protecting the rest of your save if that save file couldn't be read cleanly first -- which could silently erase your tutorial-complete status (and other saved progress) and get worse on every following match.
fixes: Completing a match, a Recovery Road challenge, a Story stage, or a Trials battle could each save your profile back to disk after only reading part of it, instead of your whole save. If that save file ever failed to load cleanly first (most likely after the app was interrupted mid-save on a phone), this would silently wipe the rest of your progress -- including marking the Academy tutorial as not-complete -- and every match after that would send you straight back into the tutorial with no way out. All of these now check that your full save loaded successfully before writing anything back, so a bad read can no longer erase real progress.
